name: Cave Castle Cavalier
source:
Kingdom Iritutus is located underground. Main character gets a mission to clear eight levels of the dungeon, prevent devil resurrection and regain peace for the kingdom.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/11/vn-of-month-february-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
Iritutus王国位于地下。主人公接到任务，要闯过地下城的八层，阻止恶魔复活，让王国重获和平。

[来源：[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/11/vn-of-month-february-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
